description: WRITE tool — delete a product in the caller's Sonar workspace and untrack every app linked to it, with their tracked keywords, discovered keywords, and competitor links. The product's screenshot sets are deleted too. Shared store data (app metadata, snapshots, rank history) is not deleted. Returns { id, deleted, untracked_apps }. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

product_id.description: Sonar product UUID — the `id` returned by sonar_list_products or sonar_create_product.

name: sonar_delete_product
title: Delete Product
